chain_correspondence.definition: Optimal assignment of chains maximizing total TM-score
chain_correspondence.fidelity: Optimal for cost matrix; simplified from US-align's exhaustive search
chain_correspondence.deviation: US-align uses C1!/C2! permutations; we use Hungarian which is optimal for bipartite matching

structural_alphabet.definition: Foldseek 3Di: VQ-VAE trained on tertiary interaction patterns
structural_alphabet.implemented_via: Simplified geometric binning of bond angles and torsions
structural_alphabet.fidelity: Approximate - captures local geometry but not trained VQ-VAE
structural_alphabet.deviation: Original 3Di uses neural network encoder; we use geometric discretization

superimposition.definition: Kabsch algorithm for optimal rotation minimizing RMSD
